query: What visit-note signals suggest high urgency?

per_column.name: acute_symptom_severity
per_column.rationale: Graded severity of acute symptoms is a strong, directly relevant axis for urgency analysis. Sample values are sound readings of the text (mild fatigue -> not_present/mild; low-grade fever cough -> acute_stable_mild), with reasonable not_present on silent rows.

per_column.name: vital_sign_hemodynamic_abnormality
per_column.rationale: Vital-sign/hemodynamic abnormality is a classic urgency signal and a genuine new grouping axis. Values look grounded (BP 128/82 -> mild_or_stable; no vitals -> not_present). Slight risk of over-reading 'mild_or_stable' from an essentially normal BP, but not a clear hallucination.

per_column.name: life_threat_or_organ_failure_present
per_column.rationale: Presence of life-threat/organ failure is highly discriminative for urgency. Samples correctly return not_present for benign visits (post-MI follow-up with stable EF -> not_present). Warranted inference on silent rows.

per_column.name: urgent_diagnostic_testing_imaging
per_column.rationale: Test/imaging urgency is a meaningful behavioral signal for urgency and adds analytical leverage. Values well grounded (MRI ordered for acute injury -> urgent_testing_same_visit; routine labs -> routine_or_deferred_testing).

per_column.name: acute_intervention_or_procedure_urgency
per_column.rationale: Procedure/intervention urgency is a useful distinct axis. Mostly grounded, though labeling topical adapalene/doxycycline as 'scheduled_or_elective_procedure' is a slight stretch since medication starts are not procedures; minor over-reach lowers groundedness modestly.

per_column.name: department_urgency_category
per_column.rationale: A deterministic recoding of the existing 'department' column into an urgency tier. Grounded and legitimate, but largely redundant with an original column and coarse (only 3 values), so it offers limited new analytical leverage.

judge.rationale: The clinical-signal columns (symptom severity, hemodynamic abnormality, life-threat/organ failure, urgent testing, intervention urgency) each provide genuine, distinct axes directly aligned with identifying high-urgency visit-note signals, and their sample values are sound readings of the source text with appropriate not_present on silent rows. The department_urgency_category column is grounded but largely a recoding of an existing column, adding little. Minor over-reads (calling a medication start an elective procedure) are the only groundedness concerns, and no clear hallucinations were observed.
